title: Fong Nan Woo

Date 21/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
April 15th 1916
（左侧竖排文字及印章：Please return this note to CENTRAL REGISTRY when dealt with.）
Sir,
It is reported that on the afternoon of 14th instant the rebels sent a communication to General Yang requesting him to declare independence, and threatening that an attack would be made on the Arsenal if he failed to do so. General Yang replied that he will declare independence but gave no date.
Owing to a report that the rebels intend to attack the Police Stations in Chapel, extraordinary precautions are being taken in that district. On the night of the 13th instant no traffic was allowed on Paoshan Road, the railway gates at the crossing being left open to block that thoroughfare.
It is reported that nine hundred men armed with rifles and two machine guns arrived at Sungkiang from Woosung on the morning of the 14th instant. It is said that these men began to loot on reaching Sungkiang. The local General turned out his troops who restored order. Some of the looters while others ran away. General Yang has given instructions to have the captured men shot.
The Chekiang troops at Pungching are entrenching.
General Fong Nan Woo 方成五 arrived at the Arsenal today from Peking with several valuable present for General Yang.
It is reported that the Shanghai rebels are trying to organise a national assembly which will meet at No. 203 Avenue Joffre opposite Yah Bing Leo 亚炳里 alleyway.
It is reported that the rebels have employed 25 mechanics to repair and put together some rifles which have been smuggled here in pieces. The work is being done in a house in the western part of Frenchtown.
It is reported that the rebels have offered Chapel to Japan as security for a loan which they are trying to arrange.
It is reported that Hupeh has declared independence and that one Li Tien Zai 李天宰 has been elected Tutuh of that province.
On the 13th instant the 3rd regiment consisting of four hundred and fifty men left Kiangnan Arsenal for Nanking. They travelled by a transport steamer.

刑事侦缉处
情报官申请
第 266 号
日期 1916年4月21日
上海公共租界工部局警务处
（印：上海公共租界工部局警察部队）
警察部队，
（侦探分部）
1916年4月15日
（左侧竖排文字及印章：处理完毕后请将此便条退回中央登记处。）

先生，

据报，本月14日下午，叛军向杨将军发送函件，要求其宣布独立，并威胁若其不照办，将攻击兵工厂。杨将军回复称他将宣布独立，但未给出具体日期。

由于有报告称叛军意图攻击闸北的警察局，该地区正采取特别预防措施。本月13日晚，宝山路禁止一切交通通行，道口处的铁路闸门保持开启状态以封锁该主干道。

据报，本月14日上午，九百名配备步枪和两挺机枪的士兵从吴淞抵达松江。据说这些人抵达松江后开始劫掠。当地将军出动部队恢复了秩序。部分劫掠者被抓获，其余人逃散。杨将军已下令枪决被俘人员。

驻奉贤的浙江部队正在构筑战壕。

方成五将军今日携带数件贵重礼物从北京抵达兵工厂，献给杨将军。

据报，上海叛军正试图组织一个国民大会，会议地点设在亚炳里巷对面的霞飞路203号。

据报，叛军已雇佣25名技工，修理并组装一些被拆解走私至此的步枪。这项工作正在法租界西部的一所房屋内进行。

据报，叛军已将闸北作为抵押品提供给日本，以担保其正在洽谈的一笔贷款。

据报，湖北已宣布独立，李天宰当选为该省都督。

本月13日，由四百五十人组成的第三团离开江南兵工厂前往南京。他们乘坐运输船前往。

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
191
(2)
At 2.30 a.m. 14th instant a shell alleged to have come
from the direction of the Arsenal struck a Chinese dyeing
shop on Wong Ka Koo 王家厍 Road near West Gate.
It is reported that Chen Chi Mei has presented a
bill to the rebel headquarters for $1,300.00 which he
maintains he spent in causing two outbreaks of fire
in the City on the night of the 12th instant.
Residents from the City and vicinity of the
Arsenal are removing to the Settlement.
Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警察部队）
警察部队，
（侦探分部）
191
(2)

本月14日凌晨2时30分，一枚据称来自兵工厂方向的炮弹击中了西门附近王家厍路的一家中国染坊。

据报，陈其美已向叛军总部提交了一份金额为1,300.00美元的账单，声称这笔费用用于在本月12日晚于城内制造两起火灾。

来自城内及兵工厂附近的居民正迁往租界。

您忠实的仆人，
首席侦探督察长。
警察总监。
